email_body:
Dear Qargo team,

I'm applying for the Regional Marketing Specialist role in Ghent. Your focus on the Netherlands and the chance to help shape a more structured campaign approach caught my attention. I'm a digital marketer with a technical background, working where SEO, content and web meet. I build and optimise websites for traditional and AI-powered search, write content that ranks, and use AI tools and code to automate repetitive work. I want to bring that mix to a team and turn websites into measurable sources of organic growth.

In my current freelance and junior roles, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and SEO content for client websites, tracking results with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Search Console. I also manage CMS content in WordPress and have built and optimised multi-page sites with structured data and technical SEO audits. I'm fluent in English and comfortable working with data and reporting to improve campaigns.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to Qargo's regional marketing.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Qargo team,

I'm writing to apply for the Regional Marketing Specialist role in Ghent. Qargo's all-in-one transport management platform and its growth across Europe caught my attention, and the chance to own regional marketing for the Netherlands while helping build a more structured campaign approach is exactly the kind of hands-on, strategic work I want to do.

I'm a digital marketer with a technical background, working where SEO, content and web meet. I build and optimise websites for traditional and AI-powered search, write content that ranks, and use AI tools and code to automate repetitive work. In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and SEO content for client websites, tracking results with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Search Console. I manage CMS content in WordPress, including publishing and updating pages, blog posts and media, and I've built and optimised multi-page sites with structured data and technical SEO audits that measurably improved search health.

While my experience is not in B2B SaaS or logistics, I've worked on client websites across consultancy and e-commerce, and I'm comfortable working with data and reporting to measure performance and improve campaigns. I'm fluent in English and have a working knowledge of Dutch, with writing at B1 and speaking at A2+. I'm proactive and independent, and I enjoy collaborating with sales teams, agencies and other stakeholders to align marketing with business goals.

I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how my SEO, content and analytical skills can support Qargo's regional marketing for the Netherlands and beyond.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

• Junior Digital Marketer at Episto: on-page SEO, keyword research and SEO content for client websites, tracking results with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Search Console; CMS content management in WordPress (Elementor, Astra, Rank Math).
